description: This file defines the Popup class for the Leaflet mapping library, extending DivOverlay. It includes methods for creating, opening, closing, and managing popups on a map, as well as binding popups to layers. It also modifies Map and Layer prototypes to support popup interactions.

classes.name: Popup
classes.description: A class extending DivOverlay used to create and manage popups on the map, with options for size, auto-panning, close button, and event handling.

methods.name: openOn
methods.description: Adds the popup to the map and makes it the active popup.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles actions when the popup is added to the map, including firing events and setting up source layer event propagation.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the popup is removed from the map, including firing events and removing event listeners.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns the event handlers for the popup, including auto-pan and click-to-close behaviors.

methods.name: _initLayout
methods.description: Initializes the DOM layout for the popup, including content container, close button, and tip.

methods.name: _updateLayout
methods.description: Adjusts the popup layout based on content size and max/min width constraints.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Handles popup position adjustment during map zoom animations.

methods.name: _adjustPan
methods.description: Automatically pans the map to keep the popup in view if autoPan is enabled.

methods.name: _onCloseButtonClick
methods.description: Handles click event on the close button to close the popup.

methods.name: _getAnchor
methods.description: Calculates the anchor point for the popup based on its source layer.
